steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil over medium heat until softened.
Stir in cumin and chili powder; toast 30 seconds.
Add diced tomatoes and chicken broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in shredded chicken; warm through.
Fry tortilla strips in oil until crisp; drain on paper towel.
Ladle soup into bowls; top with tortilla strips, lime, cilantro.
Char poblanos and tomatillos under broiler; peel and chop.
Brown chicken thighs in heavy pot; remove.
Sauté onion and garlic in pan drippings.
Add charred vegetables and stock; simmer 30 minutes.
Return chicken to pot; cook until tender; shred.
Finish with epazote and oregano; serve with queso fresco and tortilla strips.
Combine all ingredients except chips in slow cooker.
Cook on low for 6 hours or high for 3 hours.
Shred chicken with two forks; stir back into soup.
Crush tortilla chips over each bowl just before serving.
Sauté onion, garlic, and jalapeño in Instant Pot on sauté mode.
Add chicken, tomatoes, stock, cumin, coriander.
Pressure cook on high 12 minutes; quick release.
Shred chicken; stir lime juice into broth.
Top each bowl with avocado, cilantro, tortilla strips.
Simmer whole chicken with onion, garlic, carrot, celery, bay leaf for 1 hour.
Toast and rehydrate ancho and guajillo chiles; blend with tomato.
Strain stock; return to pot. Stir in chile-tomato purée.
Shred chicken; return meat to pot.
Fry tortilla strips; serve atop soup with queso fresco, lime, cilantro.
